name: SN 2016iae field (Hubble)
blurb: SN 2016iae field, the site of a recent nearby supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2016iaefield-hubble
story: This field marks where the supernova SN 2016iae went off. Hubble returned to the sites of recent, nearby supernovae to follow their lingering light and study the stars around them.

claims.text: SN 2016iae was a target of Hubble program 15166, a snapshot survey of the sites of recent, nearby supernovae
The program obtains late-time photometry of supernova sites and measures their local stellar environments
